headline: Indian IT services showed mixed growth with a few high‑flying firms and overall modest revenue expansion.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, while Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance. AI‑related deals were highlighted across most firms, but only a few disclosed concrete AI revenue figures.

themes.title: AI‑driven deal momentum
themes.detail: Several companies cited AI‑led contracts and revenue growth, though only Mphasis and HCLTech gave specific AI revenue numbers.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, while HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% outlook.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins rose at TCS (24%) and HCLTech (18.2%), reflecting better cost control.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 39.9% YoY, the strongest growth among listed firms.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
Revenue growth modest at 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and guidance was weak.
